clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Deathguard Samsa watches the tense frontier and sends travelers against threats near the settlement.

Deathguard Samsa keeps watch in Tarren Mill, where the Forsaken hold their ground in the contested Hillsbrad Foothills. Horde sentries face pressure from Alliance outposts such as Southshore and from savage local wildlife. Samsa guards the perimeter and directs capable adventurers against threats before they endanger the encampment.
